intro: CodeGlyphX ships features first; ImagePlayground exposes them as commands. This table describes ImagePlayground 3.3.0: rows marked available work from commands alone, partial rows work with the limits noted, and planned rows are in CodeGlyphX but not yet a command.

tracking.title: Request a command or vote on the roadmap

rows.capability: QR codes from any text or URL
Colours, module size, transparent background and a centre logo
PNG, JPEG, SVG and PDF output, chosen by file extension
Error-correction level, quiet zone and exact output size
Module shapes, finder (eye) shapes, eye colour and logo scale
Gradients, palettes and canvas backgrounds
rows.note: The styling the playground shows today.

rows.capability: QR artwork: theme presets, procedural patterns and image composition
Micro QR and rMQR
rows.note: CodeGlyphX encodes them; no command exposes them yet.

rows.capability: Static scan-readiness report for styled codes
Wi-Fi, contact cards, email, phone and SMS
Authenticator secrets, calendar events and locations
Payments: GiroCode, BezahlCode, Swiss QR bill and Slovenian UPN
Bitcoin, Monero, ShadowSocks and Skype calls
UPI and PayPal.Me payments
WhatsApp messages, MMS and bookmarks
App store links and social profiles (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, TikTok)
Retail and logistics: EAN, UPC, ITF-14, Code 128 and GS1-128
Industrial linear codes: Code 39, Code 93, Code 11, Codabar, MSI, Plessey, Telepen, 2 of 5 variants, Pharmacode and Code 32
Data Matrix and PDF417
GS1 DataBar, MicroPDF417 and postal codes (POSTNET, PLANET, Royal Mail, Japan Post, USPS IMb, KIX)
rows.note: They encode today; reading them back with Get-ImageBarCode is not reliable yet.

rows.capability: Aztec, DotCode, Han Xin and the rest of the CodeGlyphX symbology list
rows.note: They encode through -Type. Reading Aztec back does not work yet, and MaxiCode needs its own renderer.

rows.capability: Bar height, module width, quiet zone, colours and human-readable text
Read a QR code from an image file
Read linear and 2D barcodes from an image file
Format filters and time limits for untrusted images
Several codes in one image, and decoding from the clipboard or screen
